classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding original and image lengths and divide image by original. The supplied separate diagrams already show the complete lengths, removing the need to reconstruct them from the overlapping figures.

content.prompt:
Determine the scale factor of the following pairs of similar figures.
It is helpful to redraw as two separate diagrams.

spec.description: Nested rectangles sharing D above the supplied Original and Image redraws, arranged left to right. Red and blue retain original/image identity; source teal is mapped to house blue.
spec.mathematics: AD = 2 cm, EA = 4 cm, ED = 6 cm. ABCD corresponds to EFGD. The image's linear dimensions are three times the original's.
spec.answerVisibility: All figures, labels and supplied redraw dimensions remain visible; the scale factor is answer-only.

spec.description: Nested similar triangles above separate Original ADE and Image ABC redraws. Preserve triangle, cross and dot correspondence markers, and both adjacent side-length givens.
spec.mathematics: D lies on AB, E lies on AC and DE is parallel to BC. AE = 5 cm, EC = 4 cm and AC = 9 cm. A corresponds to A, D to B and E to C.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied nested figure and both redraws remain visible, including AC = 9 cm. The scale factor is answer-only.
